en.before: | 6.1.2 - define and apply a risk assessment process | **8.2** - perform assessments at planned intervals or when significant changes are proposed or occur |
en.after: | 6.1.2 - define and apply a risk assessment process | **8.2** - perform assessments at planned intervals, and whenever significant change is proposed or happens |

en.before: **8.2's trigger is worth reading precisely:** at planned intervals **or when significant changes are proposed or occur**. Two triggers. An organization that assesses annually and had a major system migration in June has an 8.2 question that annual scheduling does not answer.
en.after: **8.2's trigger is worth reading precisely:** at planned intervals **and whenever significant change is proposed or happens**. Two triggers. An organization that assesses annually and had a major system migration in June has an 8.2 question that annual scheduling does not answer.

en.before: Clause 8.1 requires the organization to plan, implement and control the processes needed to meet requirements and implement the clause 6 actions, by:
en.after: Clause 8.1 requires the organization to plan, run and control the processes it needs in order to meet requirements and carry out the clause 6 actions, by:

en.before: - **implementing control of the processes in accordance with the criteria**
- **Documented information shall be available** to the extent necessary to have confidence the processes have been carried out as planned.
en.after: - **Documented information shall be kept** so far as is needed to give confidence that the processes ran the way they were planned to.

en.before: - The organization shall **control planned changes and review the consequences of unintended changes**, taking action to mitigate adverse effects as necessary.
en.after: - The organization shall **control planned changes and review what unintended changes bring about**, acting to soften adverse effects as needed.

en.before: - The organization shall ensure that **externally provided processes, products or services** relevant to the ISMS **are controlled.**
en.after: - The organization shall see that **externally provided processes, products or services** bearing on the ISMS **are controlled.**

en.before: **And note the confidence standard for documentation:** *to the extent necessary to have confidence the processes have been carried out as planned.* That is a purposive test, not a volume one - which cuts both ways in an audit.
en.after: **And note the confidence standard for documentation:** *so far as is needed to give confidence that the processes ran as planned.* That is a purposive test, not a volume one - which cuts both ways in an audit.

en.before: - a) **what needs to be monitored and measured**, including information security processes and controls
en.after: - a) **what is to be monitored and measured**, information security processes and controls included

en.before: - b) the **methods** for monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation, as applicable, to ensure valid results
en.after: - b) the **methods** used to monitor, measure, analyse and evaluate, as applicable, so results are valid

en.before: - c) **when** the monitoring and measuring shall be performed
en.after: - c) **when** monitoring and measuring shall be done

en.before: - e) **when** the results shall be analysed and evaluated
en.after: - e) **when** those results shall be analysed and evaluated

en.before: - f) **who shall analyse and evaluate** these results
en.after: - f) **who shall do that analysis and evaluation**

en.before: Note b)'s standard: methods should produce **comparable and reproducible results** to be considered valid. A metric whose definition changed mid-year is not producing comparable results.
en.after: Note b)'s standard: methods should give **comparable and reproducible results** if they are to count as valid. A metric whose definition changed mid-year is not producing comparable results.

en.after: "feedback": "Clause 8.2 requires risk assessments at planned intervals, AND whenever significant change is proposed or happens. A platform migration to a new provider is a significant change, and the annual cycle does not discharge the second trigger."
